name: sepaheld
description: Automate SEPA direct debit (Lastschrift) with SepaHeld: send mandate requests, collect invoices, explain failed payments, payouts and dunning (Mahnwesen). Requires the SepaHeld Business plan.

interface.longDescription: Send SEPA mandate requests, collect ERP invoices, find out why an invoice was not collected, handle failed payments and chargebacks, book payouts and manage dunning (Mahnwesen) in SepaHeld. Works with Lexware Office, sevDesk, Moco, Xentral, Invoiz, WISO MeinBüro and Papierkram. Requires the SepaHeld Business plan.
